scope: Predeclared paired native policies on complete known originals; all original cases/source/reference pins/limits retained. No new source/region choice, row repair, profile winner or held-out claim.

protocol.extraction: Complete original PDF per mode, native defaults plus cell geometry. No reference/page/ROI inputs to extraction; source-dependent failures retain both cases in denominator.
protocol.references: Issuer-authored SEC HTML tables by fixed document-order index. Direct tr rows for that table, direct td/th wholeText joined by ASCII space. Map NBSP to display space, collapse ASCII whitespace only, trim only those spaces, drop wholly blank rows. Preserve punctuation/case/numeric formatting and all other Unicode. SHA256 of newline-joined normalized nonblank rows without trailing newline.
protocol.selection: Fixed source pages and displayed ROIs from PDF page rendering before DocWeave extraction. Max parent IoU >=0.5, stable first-index tie; never text-based association.
protocol.comparison: Exact nonblank row text at original nonblank row index. Do not shift rows, join fragments, fuzzy match, fix parentheses/currency/numbers or use content to choose a table. Keep missing/extra rows separate.
protocol.limits: HTML presentational cells/spans are NOT labels for PDF physical topology. No physical-span accuracy, cell-box accuracy or semantic-merge claim.

discovery_failures: Investor-relations HTML download returnedHTTP403, including standard user-agent attempt; switched to public issuer-authored SEC exhibit before freezing or extraction.
